segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report mixed results: some, including one with psoriasis-prone patches, say it causes no irritation at all, while others describe tingling, burning, redness, or breakouts strong enough to make them stop using it.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one post-menopausal reviewer, generally describe the serum as gentle and hydrating without irritation, though one reviewer with dry, sensitive skin also reported tingling and breakouts.
segments.mature: Mature reviewers with visible spots and dullness report the serum evens out tone, adds brightness, and softens the look of wrinkles with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their late 40s to 50s, including a post-menopausal reviewer, report the serum gradually brightens and evens their tone and supports skin quality without irritation, describing the effect as gentle and gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report good hydration from the serum, including one with sensitive, psoriasis-prone skin who saw less dryness and flaking after several weeks of use; no reviewer reports it worsening dryness.
concerns.redness: Accounts differ: several reviewers say it caused new redness, burning, or irritation on their cheeks, while others report it caused no redness at all, and one reviewer says a patch used on rosacea-prone skin saw the redness disappear.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers describe the formula as gentle with no stinging, but a minority report a burning or tingling sensation on application, and a few describe stronger reactions such as itching, puffiness, or breakouts, with one needing medical treatment; one reviewer also reports a bad reaction after combining it with tretinoin.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers using the serum for dark spots, melasma, or postpartum hyperpigmentation, including underarms, report gradual fading and a more even tone over several weeks, but a notable minority saw zero improvement, and one reviewer's underarm area became darker again after about a month of use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers mention breakouts: one broke out on the cheeks and chin after applying it and another purged hormonal acne while also using tretinoin, while others report no new breakouts from the serum.

extraits.texte: Ok so I had heard a ton about this product on Instagram and was very interested in trying Korean skincare products. But this just isn’t for me, I have very dry and sensitive skin, I thought this would just help hydrate and brighten my face. It just ended up making my face tingle and I was breaking out a little bit on my cheeks and chin (mind you I almost never breakout in my cheeks.) I liked the way it made the rest of my face look tho 😅 it sorta gave a brighter look, but not the way I thought it would. I’m going to wait a while and try it again, just in case because I had also been using the Equaal berry NAD + peptide serum before this. So please if you are young, and already have clear skin, I’d do some research about this product. If you don’t NEED it, don’t use it. By all means try it out if you like, but keep in mind that it might be a bit heavy for sensitive or acne prone skin.

Not for My Sensitive Skin I purchased this serum because it’s very popular on social media and has received a lot of hype. Unfortunately, it did not work for me. I have sensitive skin, but I regularly use products with active ingredients and rarely experience irritation. After applying this serum, I developed noticeable redness, burning, and irritation on my cheeks. The reaction was stronger than anything I typically experience with skincare products. I stopped using it immediately, and my skin improved after discontinuing it. It may work well for others, but in my case it was not compatible with my skin. Just a reminder that not everything that goes viral on social media is automatically good for everyone. Skincare is very personal. If you have sensitive or redness-prone skin, I recommend doing a patch test first. I’m giving it two stars only because the return process was easy.

extraits.titre: My experience might be different than yours
extraits.texte: I’m writing this review based on my own personal experience. I began using this serum to lighten my underarms on March 10 and it is now April 12. I had no issues regarding stinging, only after a fresh shave. The serum started to lighten my skin in as little as 4 days to the first week. I started to notice my skin was becoming darker as time passed, and now that I’m a month in I realize it’s even darker than before when I began this journey. My routine would be to apply serum on clean and deodorant free skin every night. I don’t want to discourage anyone from trying out this product as it may work for you but this is my own experience. I will not continue using this product although I have half a bottle left..

extraits.titre: A Gentle, Supportive Brightening Serum That Improves Skin Without Overworking It
extraits.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry, increasingly sensitive skin, I approach brightening and vitamin products very carefully. Many of them promise glow and radiance but end up being too aggressive, leaving my skin dry, irritated, or compromised. At this stage, I’m far more interested in products that support skin quality over time rather than push for dramatic, fast results. This is not a miracle product — and that’s actually one of its strengths. I see this more as a supportive, gentle brightening serum that helps maintain healthy-looking skin without overworking it. It’s the kind of product that fits beautifully into a long-term routine, especially if you’re already using stronger actives or simply want something that improves tone and radiance without irritation. The texture is excellent. It has a lightweight, slightly cushioned feel that spreads easily and absorbs well. It doesn’t feel greasy, sticky, or heavy, and it layers beautifully with the rest of my routine without any fragrance. I’ve had no issues using it under moisturizer or sunscreen, and it sits well on the skin without pilling. What I appreciate most is how it improves overall skin quality. This is not a dramatic overnight product, and I think that’s important to say clearly. Instead, it’s more about steady support — helping the skin look brighter, smoother, and more even over time. My skin looks healthier and more refined when I use this consistently, and that’s exactly what I want from a vitamin serum at this
